programs.title: Susan Calman's Grand Day Out
programs.desc: Susan celebrates brilliant journeys she's had by boat and train as enjoys a new adventure at the Scottish Maritime Museum. She also recalls highlights from her escapades over the years.

programs.desc: In Newcastle police crack down on drink and drug drivers and uninsured vehicles. And with lives at risk at a crash, officers must separate the truth from lies.

programs.title: Police Interceptors

programs.title: Major Crimes Unit
programs.desc: With unprecedented access to this elite crime-fighting unit, we follow investigators racing against time to track suspects, uncover the truth, and deliver justice for victims and families.

programs.title: Police: Night Shift 999

programs.title: Traffic Cops
programs.desc: Over 80,000 motorists lose their driving licence every year and nearly ten percent of those are already banned from driving. In this edition, cops clamp down on unlicensed drivers.
